description: This file defines a React component for the Meter Data page, allowing users to upload meter CSV files and view a list of configured meters with their latest readings. It handles data fetching, mutation, and error states using react-query, and integrates components for UI and asynchronous state display.

methods.name: MetersPage
methods.description: Main React functional component for the Meter Data page, managing state, data fetching, and UI rendering.
